prompt: Find total number of atoms in 0.5 mol H₂O molecules. Use Nₐ=6.02×10²³ mol⁻¹. Enter standard form using e notation, such as 6.02e23.
explanation: .5 mol molecules contains 1.5 mol total atoms:1.5×6.02×10²³=9.03×10²³.
hint: There are three atoms per H₂O molecule.
title: Count all atoms in molecules
